title: Library
grid.label: Movies and series
connect.title: Connect your Jellyfin server
connect.intro: Jellyfin is a free, open-source media server: you keep your movies and series on it and {{app}} plays them from here, with the audio and subtitles you want.
connect.reconnectIntro: The server {{server}} asked for {{user}}'s password again. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.
connect.httpNote: Unencrypted connection (http). That is common on a home network, but avoid it away from home.
connect.passwordNote: The password is only used to sign in and is never saved: {{app}} keeps just the access key the server returns, protected by your system.
connect.tls.title: Server certificate not trusted
connect.tls.body: This server's HTTPS certificate could not be verified (self-signed, expired or issued for another address). If this is your own server, you can trust it anyway.
connect.tls.passwordAgain: Type the password again to continue.
connect.trusted: This server uses an unverified certificate and was marked as trusted by you.
server.disconnectBody: The session stored on this computer will be deleted. Your movies, series and progress stay on Jellyfin.
filter.label: Filter by type
search.label: Search the library
sort.label: Sort by
sort.title: Title (A-Z)
continue.title: Continue watching
empty.title: Your server has no movies or series yet
empty.text: Add files to your Jellyfin libraries, wait for it to finish scanning, then click Refresh.
noResults.title: Nothing found for “{{query}}”
noResults.text: Check the spelling or try another title.
favoritesEmpty.title: Your list is empty
favoritesEmpty.text: Click the heart on a movie or series to keep it here.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.unreachableBody: Check that the server is on and that this computer is on the same network.
error.notFoundBody: It may have been removed from the server or not catalogued yet. Try refreshing the library.
errors.BAD_URL: Invalid address. Use something like http://192.168.0.10:8096.
errors.UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the server. Check the address and that Jellyfin is running.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.TLS_ERROR: The server's security certificate is not trusted.
errors.NOT_JELLYFIN: That address answered, but it does not look like a Jellyfin server.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: The server returned an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Connecting to a server only works in the installed app.
errors.AUTH_EXPIRED: Your session on the server expired.
errors.SERVER_UNREACHABLE: Could not talk to the server
errors.UPSTREAM_ERROR: The server answered with an unexpected error.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find this item
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The app could not authenticate with its local service. Close and reopen the app.
errors.BACKEND_DOWN: The app's local service is not responding. Close and reopen the app.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: The local service answered something unexpected.
toast.watchedError: Could not update the watched status
